query: What are the best voice AI agents in 2025?
brief: I want to identify the best voice AI agents available in the year 2025. I am interested in comprehensive details about their capabilities, features, user experience, technology used, integration options, and performance benchmarks. Since I have not specified any particular use case, platform, language, or pricing criteria, the research should consider all major voice AI agents across different domains and applications as of 2025. Please prioritize information from official sources such as the agents' official websites, manufacturer pages, or reputable e-commerce platforms offering verified user reviews. Avoid relying on secondary aggregator sites or speculative blogs. This will help me understand the leading voice AI technologies in 2025 and choose the most suitable one for my needs.
